author: cairn
blurb: A weekly Linear digest: what shipped, what's at risk, what to tackle next.

definition.name: Linear sprint digest
definition.description: Summarises this week's Linear issues/cycles via the Linear connector and drafts a digest note.
definition.instructions: Using the attached Linear connector, fetch the project's recent issues (the current cycle and issues updated in the last 7 days). Write a 'Linear digest — <date>' note with three sections: Shipped (issues in Done), At risk (issues in Todo/In Progress with no update this week), and Suggested next (2-3 issues worth picking up, with titles). If the connector isn't attached or returns nothing, write a one-line note saying so. Do NOT create, move, or edit any Linear issues — read and summarise only.
